prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a rear-end collision. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1365; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with reported head impact and subsequent headaches, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating. The mechanism and force of the collision are consistent with the injury described. Over the course of 17 visits, care included symptom monitoring, vestibular and cognitive rest guidance, graded return-to-activity planning, and supportive therapy. Recovery has taken somewhat longer than is typical for a concussion of this kind. Most of the documented complaints are based on the patient's own reports of pain and symptom severity, as neurological examination findings and imaging have been within normal limits. The patient also reported a minor strain to the same region several years ago, which resolved completely without ongoing limitation. Billing entries for two similar services on the same date are under review for accuracy. Continued follow-up is planned to reassess symptoms and functional capacity.
